
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{background:#0e0e0e;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding:44px 16px;font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;color:#fff;min-height:100vh}
h1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:300;
  color:#C8A878;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:6px;text-align:center}
.sub{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);margin-bottom:44px;text-align:center}
.row{display:flex;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;max-width:680px}
.col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.lbl{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.32em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
/* Phone frame */
.phone{width:295px;border-radius:38px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 32px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.75),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  background:#fff}
.screen{overflow-y:scroll;max-height:620px;scrollbar-width:none}
.screen::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

/* ══ BLOSSOM ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.bl{background:#F0EBF6}

/* Hero: fresco full-bleed, lavender overlay, arch card */
.bl-hero{position:relative;height:440px;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}
.bl-hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:center 30%}
/* Lavender watercolor wash over fresco - atmospheric */
.bl-hero-wash{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover;
  opacity:.35;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
/* Dark gradient at bottom for arch readability */
.bl-hero-grad{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,
    transparent 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    rgba(220,210,235,.4) 65%,
    rgba(240,235,246,.95) 100%)}
/* White arch card */
.bl-arch{position:relative;z-index:3;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  border-radius:999px 999px 0 0;
  width:78%;padding:38px 26px 46px;text-align:center;
  box-shadow:0 -20px 60px rgba(140,120,180,.2)}
.bl-eyebrow{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.4em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#9580B8;display:block;margin-bottom:14px}
.bl-names{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:40px;color:#1E1228;
  line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:8px}
.bl-amp{font-size:.68em;font-style:italic;color:#9580B8;opacity:.8}
.bl-date{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#9580B8}

/* Couple photo section — full-width with arch frame */
.bl-couple-wrap{position:relative;background:#F0EBF6;padding:20px 20px 0}
.bl-couple-arch{border-radius:999px 999px 0 0;overflow:hidden;
  height:360px;position:relative}
.bl-couple-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 15%}
.bl-couple-caption{text-align:center;padding:16px 0 20px;
  font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.24em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#9580B8}

/* Quote section */
.bl-quote-sec{background:#F0EBF6;padding:24px 20px}
.bl-quote-inner{background:white;border-radius:18px;padding:24px 18px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(140,120,180,.1)}
.bl-quote-wash{position:absolute;bottom:-20px;right:-20px;width:130px;
  opacity:.12;transform:rotate(15deg);pointer-events:none}
.bl-ql{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.28em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#9580B8;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.bl-qmark{position:absolute;top:-8px;left:10px;
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:100px;
  color:#E8E0F2;line-height:1;z-index:0}
.bl-qt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:17px;color:#1E1228;line-height:1.7;
  position:relative;z-index:1}
.bl-qs{font-size:11px;color:#9580B8;margin-top:9px;
  display:block;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* Calendar — lavender watercolor background */
.bl-cal-sec{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:36px 20px;text-align:center}
.bl-cal-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;opacity:.9}
.bl-cal-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:rgba(120,90,170,.15)}
.bl-cal-content{position:relative;z-index:2}
.bl-cal-month{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:32px;
  color:white;margin-bottom:18px;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(80,50,120,.4)}
.bl-cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px;
  max-width:210px;margin:0 auto}
.bl-wd{font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  text-align:center;padding:3px 0}
.bl-day{aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);border-radius:50%}
.bl-day.a{background:white;color:#7A5AB0;font-weight:700;
  box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.bl-day.p{opacity:.22}
/* Countdown */
.bl-cd{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:22px}
.bl-cdb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  border-radius:10px;padding:10px 10px;min-width:50px;text-align:center}
.bl-cdn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:26px;
  color:white;line-height:1;display:block;
  text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.bl-cdl{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);display:block;margin-top:3px}

/* Ceremony */
.bl-cer-sec{background:#F0EBF6;padding:24px 18px}
.bl-cer-card{background:white;border-radius:18px;padding:24px 18px;
  text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(140,120,180,.1)}
.bl-cer-ico{font-size:34px;margin-bottom:10px}
.bl-cer-title{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:30px;
  color:#1E1228;margin-bottom:10px}
.bl-cer-name{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:400;color:#1E1228;margin-bottom:5px}
.bl-cer-time{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:#F0EAF8;border-radius:100px;padding:8px 16px;
  font-size:12.5px;color:#9580B8;margin:9px 0}
.bl-cer-addr{font-size:11.5px;color:#7A6A8A;font-weight:300;line-height:1.65}
.bl-map-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B098CC,#9580B8);
  color:white;border:none;border-radius:100px;
  padding:9px 20px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;margin-top:12px}

/* Timing */
.bl-timing-sec{background:white;padding:24px 18px;
  margin:0 18px;border-radius:18px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(140,120,180,.08);
  margin:0 18px 20px}
.bl-timing-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:22px;color:#1E1228;text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.bl-tr{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(180,160,210,.15)}
.bl-tr:last-child{border:none}
.bl-tt{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;color:#9580B8;min-width:44px}
.bl-te{font-size:12.5px;color:#3A2A4A;font-weight:300}

/* RSVP */
.bl-rsvp{position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  padding:36px 20px;text-align:center}
.bl-rsvp-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;opacity:.85}
.bl-rsvp-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:rgba(100,70,150,.55)}
.bl-rsvp-content{position:relative;z-index:2}
.bl-rsvp-title{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:38px;
  color:white;margin-bottom:6px;
  text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.bl-rsvp-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:300}
.bl-rf{width:100%;padding:11px 16px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  border-radius:100px;color:white;
  font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
  outline:none;margin-bottom:9px;text-align:center}
.bl-rf::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.bl-rb{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  color:#7A5AB0;border:none;border-radius:100px;padding:12px;
  font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:600}
.bl-radios{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bl-radio{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);cursor:pointer}

.bl-footer{background:#1E1228;padding:18px;text-align:center}
.bl-fb{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:21px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.bl-fb span{color:#C8A060}

/* ══ MONO ══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.mn{background:#FAFAFA}

/* Hero: silhouette full-height, dramatic */
.mn-hero{position:relative;height:380px;overflow:hidden;background:#0A0A0A}
.mn-hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:center;
  filter:contrast(1.15) brightness(.9)}
/* Ink wash decorative corner */
.mn-ink-tl{position:absolute;top:-10px;left:-10px;width:220px;
  opacity:.4;transform:rotate(5deg) scaleY(-1);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;pointer-events:none}
.mn-hero-content{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;
  padding:28px 24px 32px;
  background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 0%,transparent 100%)}
.mn-hero-eyebrow{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:8px;
  letter-spacing:.36em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.mn-names{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:44px;
  font-weight:300;color:white;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.mn-amp{display:block;font-style:italic;font-size:.48em;opacity:.35;margin:3px 0}
.mn-date{display:inline-block;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  padding:6px 18px;font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:8.5px;
  letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:12px}

/* Couple photo in arch - portrait section */
.mn-couple-sec{background:#F8F8F8;padding:24px 22px;text-align:center}
.mn-couple-arch{border-radius:999px 999px 4px 4px;overflow:hidden;
  height:320px;position:relative;margin:0 20px}
.mn-couple-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;
  filter:grayscale(100%) contrast(1.05)}
.mn-couple-label{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:15px;color:#888;margin-top:14px;display:block}

.mn-rule{height:1px;background:#111}
.mn-rule-lt{height:1px;background:#E8E8E8}

/* Quote with ink decoration */
.mn-quote-sec{background:white;padding:28px 22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.mn-ink-bg{position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-20px;width:200px;
  opacity:.06;transform:rotate(-5deg);pointer-events:none}
.mn-ql{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#888;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.mn-qmark{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:80px;
  line-height:.8;color:#DDD;display:block;margin-bottom:-8px}
.mn-qt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:17px;color:#1A1A1A;line-height:1.72}
.mn-qsrc{font-size:11px;color:#999;margin-top:9px;display:block}

/* Dark calendar section */
.mn-dark{background:#0A0A0A;padding:36px 22px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
/* Fern decoration in dark section */
.mn-fern{position:absolute;bottom:-10px;right:-20px;width:180px;
  opacity:.12;transform:rotate(-10deg);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none}
.mn-cal-month{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:30px;color:white;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px;
  max-width:210px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-wd{font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  text-align:center;padding:2px 0}
.mn-day{aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:50%}
.mn-day.a{background:white;color:#0A0A0A;font-weight:700}
.mn-day.p{opacity:.18}
/* Big countdown */
.mn-cd{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;align-items:baseline;
  margin-top:26px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-cdn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:42px;color:white;
  line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.mn-cdl{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:7.5px;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:3px}
.mn-sep{font-size:28px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding-bottom:14px}

/* Ceremony */
.mn-cer-sec{background:white;padding:26px 22px}
.mn-cer-label{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:8.5px;
  letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#888;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.mn-cer-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:26px;color:#111;margin-bottom:16px}
.mn-cer-row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;
  padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #EAEAEA}
.mn-cer-row:last-child{border:none}
.mn-cer-ico{font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px}
.mn-cer-lbl{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#AAA;margin-bottom:3px}
.mn-cer-val{font-size:14px;color:#111;margin-bottom:1px}
.mn-cer-sub{font-size:12px;color:#666;font-weight:300}
/* Fern divider between rows */
.mn-fern-divider{width:60px;margin:14px auto;display:block;opacity:.35;
  filter:grayscale(100%)}

/* Timing */
.mn-timing-sec{background:#F6F6F6;padding:24px 22px}
.mn-timing-label{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:8.5px;
  letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#888;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.mn-timing-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:24px;color:#111;margin-bottom:14px}
.mn-tr{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #EBEBEB}
.mn-tr:last-child{border:none}
.mn-tt{font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;
  color:#999;min-width:44px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.mn-dash{color:#CCC;margin:0 10px}
.mn-te{font-size:13px;color:#222}

/* RSVP - white on black */
.mn-rsvp-sec{background:#0A0A0A;padding:36px 22px;text-align:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.mn-rsvp-ink{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:200px;
  opacity:.1;mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none;transform:rotate(180deg)}
.mn-rsvp-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:34px;color:white;margin-bottom:6px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-rsvp-sub{font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:18px;
  letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-rf{width:100%;padding:11px 14px;background:white;border:none;border-radius:2px;
  font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11.5px;outline:none;
  margin-bottom:8px;color:#111;letter-spacing:.05em;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mn-rf::placeholder{color:#AAA}
.mn-rb{width:100%;background:white;color:#0A0A0A;border:none;padding:12px;
  font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:700;position:relative;z-index:1}

.mn-footer{background:#0A0A0A;padding:18px;text-align:center;
  border-top:1px solid #1a1a1a}
.mn-fb{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.mn-fb span{color:#A87C3E}
